requests.title: Email Finder Requests
requests.description: List of people to find. Each request needs a company (`domain` or `company` name) and a name (`fullName`, or `firstName` and `lastName`).

domain.title: Domain
domain.description: Company domain name (e.g., 'stripe.com'). Required unless `company` is set

firstName.title: First Name
firstName.description: Person's first name. Required with `lastName` unless `fullName` is set

lastName.title: Last Name
lastName.description: Person's last name. Required with `firstName` unless `fullName` is set

fullName.title: Full Name
fullName.description: Person's full name (e.g., 'John Doe'). Alternative to `firstName` + `lastName`

maxResults.title: Maximum Results
maxResults.description: Maximum number of requests to process (default: 50, max: 1000)

enrichMobile.title: Find phone numbers
enrichMobile.description: Also return the person's phone numbers in `phone_data`. A result with phone data costs 6 credits instead of 1; results without phone data still cost 1 credit.

webhookUrl.title: Webhook URL
webhookUrl.description: Optional URL that Tomba notifies when a result is ready (sent to Tomba as `webhook_url`).

maxConcurrency.title: Max concurrency
maxConcurrency.description: How many Tomba requests run in parallel. There is no rate limit, so raise it for large lists.
maxConcurrency.sectionDescription: Concurrency, retry and cache settings. The defaults work well for most runs.

maxRetries.title: Max retries
maxRetries.description: How many times to retry a request after a network error, 429 or 5xx response (exponential backoff). Failed requests are never charged.

useCache.title: Use cache
useCache.description: Reuse results from previous runs for identical requests. Cached results are free.

cacheTtlHours.title: Cache TTL (hours)
cacheTtlHours.description: How long cached results stay valid. 0 disables the cross-run cache.
